feature: Scoped GNU Screen mouse-input recovery and exact-thread restart
observed_cause: SGR mouse-coordinate report tails entered the native composer while pointer capture was enabled.
changes: Temporary process-identity-bound output-side mouse reset guard; no keystroke filtering or prompt injection.
Per-home inline TUI preference for the affected Screen.
Ignore unused terminal rows when detecting inline active work and unsent drafts.
Retained the affected Screen and installed a persistent shell before replacing its formerly direct launcher.

validation.optional_checks: The installed-native mouse check was also run explicitly and passed; six unrelated native goal tests were not rerun.

limitations: The guard is a polling mitigation with a brief re-enable interval, not a parser patch. It is no longer needed for the restarted inline session.
